jobs.title: BHEL Engineer/Executive & Supervisor Trainee 2027: 415 Posts
jobs.summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited has announced 415 trainee posts: 200 Engineer/Executive Trainee and 215 Supervisor Trainee across Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Civil, IT/CS, HR and Finance. Apply online from 25 November to 28 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Engineer Trainee – full-time B.E./B.Tech; Executive Trainee – CA/CMA (Finance) or HR PG/MBA; Supervisor Trainee – engineering diploma, BBA/BBS/BMS or B.Com
Age: in the detailed notification (from 25 Nov 2026)
Pay: in the detailed notification
Selection: Computer Based Examination
Dates: apply 25 Nov – 28 Dec 2026

jobs.title: IAF AFCAT 01/2027: 284 Flying and Ground Duty Officer Posts
jobs.summary: The Indian Air Force has notified AFCAT 01/2027 for 284 officer vacancies in the Flying and Ground Duty (Technical and Non-Technical) branches, including GATE Score Entry. Graduates and B.E./B.Tech candidates can apply online by 11 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: Flying – any graduation or B.E./B.Tech with Physics & Maths in 10+2; Technical – 4-yr B.E./B.Tech in notified branches; Admin/Logistics – any graduation
Final year: can apply (no backlog; proof by 30 Nov 2027)
Age: Flying 20–24, Ground Duty 20–26 years (as on 1 Jan 2028)
Fee: Rs 550 + GST
Selection: AFCAT online exam, AFSB, CPSS (Flying), medical
Dates: apply 12 Nov – 11 Dec 2026; exam 31 Jan 2027

jobs.title: JKSSB Junior Engineer (Mechanical) 2026: 127 Posts
jobs.summary: JKSSB has advertised 127 Junior Engineer (Mechanical) posts in the Public Works (R&B) Department of J&K (Advt 10 of 2026). J&K domicile candidates with a Mechanical diploma or degree can apply online from 23 November to 22 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: 3-yr Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or AMIE (A&B); Aeronautical/Automobile/Production equivalent; J&K domicile
Age: max 40 (OM), 43 (reserved), 42 (PwD) as on 01.01.2026
Fee: Rs 600; Rs 500 for SC/ST/EWS/PwBD
Selection: written/OMR objective exam with 1/4 negative marking, document verification
Dates: apply 23 Nov – 22 Dec 2026

jobs.title: KEA Industrial Expansion Officer 2026: 35 Posts
jobs.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority has notified 35 Industrial Expansion Officer posts (pay scale Rs 54,175 – 99,400). B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com and BBA graduates can apply online by 15 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech, or Bachelor's in Science, Commerce or Business Administration/Management (result-awaited not eligible)
Fee: Rs 750 (GM); Rs 500 (SC/ST/Cat-1); Rs 250 (PwD)
Selection: Paper-1 GK + Paper-2 Specific, Kannada Language Test, document verification
Dates: apply 18 Nov – 15 Dec 2026; exam Feb 2027

jobs.title: Mumbai Port Authority Graduate Apprentice 2026: 48 Posts
jobs.summary: Mumbai Port Authority has 48 Graduate Apprentice seats for graduates of any stream, with a stipend of Rs 12,300 a month for 12 months. Register on NATS 2.0 and send the application offline by 18 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: graduate in any stream; NATS 2.0 registration
Age: 18–25 years as on 01-11-2026
Stipend: Rs 12,300 per month
Dates: last date 18 Dec 2026 (5 PM, offline)
